faq.heading: A few quick answers
faq.a1: The illustration shows a child tapping a meal card and a collection confirmation appearing for the parent. This demo has no connected reader. A collection record does not confirm that the meal was eaten.
faq.a2: You review the calculated KWD total before confirming. Payment and refunds are simulated in this demo; no KNET transaction takes place.
faq.q3: My child has an allergy. How does that get handled?
faq.a3: The programme statement names Nuts, Shellfish, Sesame and Soy. Dish records are sample information. Student allergy notes are reference notes only; the demo does not check or match allergies automatically. Contact the team about a specific dietary requirement.
faq.q4: What if I need to cancel a booking?
faq.a4: History lets you cancel a booking marked Upcoming. The demo records a simulated refund; it does not move money.
faq.footnote: Booking, pricing, and the full parent journey: see {parents}. Platform-wide capabilities: see {features}.

problem.heading: Meal coordination shouldn't run through paper and WhatsApp.
problem.intro: Most school meal programmes are held together by phone calls, spreadsheets, and group chats between administration, parents, and the catering kitchen — with no single record either side can check.
problem.item1Body: Parent requests, payments, and allergy notes scattered across calls, messages, and paper forms.
problem.item2Body: Administration staff reconciling orders and payments by hand, school day after school day.
problem.item3Body: No shared, real-time record of who booked, who paid, or who actually collected a meal.

connectedModel.heading: One connected programme, not three separate processes.
connectedModel.intro: Your school, your parents, and your catering partner all work from the same live booking and calendar data — instead of three separate, disconnected processes.
connectedModel.item2: A structured commercial programme, not just software
connectedModel.item3: New revenue opportunities from a digitally run programme
connectedModel.item4: A real partnership — not a vendor relationship

parentExperience.heading: Higher parent engagement, less admin overhead for you.
parentExperience.intro: Parents book directly, pay only for the real school days their plan covers, and get a notification the moment their child collects lunch — instead of calling your office to ask.

operationalVisibility.heading: What actually changes for your administration.
operationalVisibility.card1Body: Subscriptions and orders run themselves — no more chasing forms.
operationalVisibility.card2Body: See bookings, collections, and trends as they happen, not at month-end.
operationalVisibility.card3Body: Replaces manual processes with one system your whole administration uses.

studentIdentification.heading: The right meal, matched to the right student, every time.
studentIdentification.body: Student-level identification means a collection is never guessed — it's tapped, matched, and logged, with allergy information carried alongside the order rather than tracked separately.
